votes.motion: Adopt Joint Resolution 34 of 2024 declaring October 2024 Italian-American Heritage Month in Salt Lake City
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing October as Italian-American Heritage Month in Salt Lake City, honoring the history and contributions of Italian Americans to the city.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Resolution 35 of 2024 declaring September 15 to October 15 Hispanic Heritage Month in Salt Lake City
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing September 15 to October 15 as Hispanic Heritage Month in Salt Lake City, celebrating the contributions of Hispanic and Latino residents.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 79 of 2024 (Salt Lake City International Center Maximum Fence Height Zoning Text Amendment)
votes.description: Closes the public hearing and adopts an ordinance amending Title 21A to increase the maximum front yard fence height in M-1 zoning districts of the Salt Lake City International Center from four feet to six feet.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer item B-2 (Eviction Protection Grant) to a future consent agenda for action
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a HUD grant application from the Housing Stability Division to support low-income tenants at risk of eviction and fund two existing full-time positions, and refers the item to a future consent agenda.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer the Mosquito Abatement District Property Tax Report item to the District Board of Trustees December 19, 2024 meeting for the public hearing and action
votes.description: Closes the Council's public hearing on the Salt Lake City Mosquito Abatement District's proposed property tax increase and refers the matter to the District Board of Trustees for their own public hearing and vote on December 19, 2024.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 36 of 2024 adopting the 900 South Housing Transit Reinvestment Zone Interlocal Agreement between Salt Lake City Corporation and the Redevelopment Agency of Salt Lake City
votes.description: Approves the interlocal agreement required by State code to create the 900 South Housing and Transit Reinvestment Zone project area, outlining participating taxing entities, tax increment participation rates, collection term, and planned utilization of tax increment funds.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 81 of 2024 amending the boundaries of the North Temple Urban Renewal Project Area
votes.description: Amends the RDA North Temple Urban Renewal Project Area boundaries to remove properties overlapping with the Utah Fairpark Area Investment and Restoration District as required by State legislation, reducing the project area to approximately half its original acreage.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 80 of 2024 approving a $300,000 loan for Ski Trucks, LLC from the Economic Development Loan Fund
votes.description: Approves a $300,000 EDLF loan to Ski Trucks, LLC, a family-owned ski and snowboard shop at 1260 West North Temple, to assist in creating two new jobs and retaining twelve existing jobs.

Approves the consent agenda including setting public hearing dates for several ordinances and approving board appointments/reappointments, including Gloria Mensah to the Racial Equity in Policing Commission and John Ewanoski to the Historic Landmark Commission.
